metadata.question: Did the land area of Smith Island decrease between 1999 and 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Smith Island, Maryland, USA (approx 37.92–38.05 N, -76.15–-75.97 W). Use a bounding polygon tightly around the island cluster to avoid mainland.
- Collections:
  - 1999: Landsat 5 and 7 Collection 2 Level 2 SR (LT05, LE07).
  - 2019: Landsat 8 (add LE07 as fallback).
- Date windows:
  - Primary: Jan 1–Dec 31 of target year.
  - Fallback: widen to ±1 year if image count is 0 or valid pixels are 0.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds, cloud shadows, cirrus, snow using QA_PIXEL bits.
- Scale SR reflectance to real values.
- Build median composite per period; compute MNDWI and classify water (MNDWI > 0), land otherwise.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- C1: If image collections for a period remain empty after fallback attempts.
- C2: If composite exists but valid pixels within AOI are 0 after masking.
- C3: If area calculation returns null/NaN.
- Otherwise compare land area 1999 vs 2019; decrease => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const aoi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [-76.15, 37.92],
    [-76.15, 38.05],
    [-75.97, 38.05],
    [-75.97, 37.92],
    [-76.15, 37.92]
  ], null, false);

  const scale = 1000; // per instruction: use >= 1000 to avoid timeout
  const maxPixels = 1e9;

  // 2. Utilities
  function maskLandsatSR(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 0).eq(0) // fill
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0))     // dilated cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))     // cirrus
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))     // cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))     // cloud shadow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));    // snow
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }
  function prepL5(img) {
    img = maskLandsatSR(img);
    const scaled = img.select(['SR_B2', 'SR_B5']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
      .rename(['green', 'swir1']);
    return scaled.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
  }
  function prepL7(img) {
    img = maskLandsatSR(img);
    const scaled = img.select(['SR_B2', 'SR_B5']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
      .rename(['green', 'swir1']);
    return scaled.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
  }
  function prepL8(img) {
    img = maskLandsatSR(img);
    const scaled = img.select(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
      .rename(['green', 'swir1']);
    return scaled.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
  }

  function getCollection(start, end, sensors) {
    let col = ee.ImageCollection([]);
    if (sensors.indexOf('L5') > -1) {
      col = col.merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(start, end).map(prepL5));
    }
    if (sensors.indexOf('L7') > -1) {
      col = col.merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(start, end).map(prepL7));
    }
    if (sensors.indexOf('L8') > -1) {
      col = col.merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(start, end).map(prepL8));
    }
    return col.select(['green', 'swir1']);
  }

  function compositeAndArea(year, primarySensors, fallbackSensors) {
    // Primary window: target year
    const primaryStart = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1);
    const primaryEnd = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 31);
    // Fallback window: ±1 year
    const fbStart = ee.Date.fromYMD(year - 1, 1, 1);
    const fbEnd = ee.Date.fromYMD(year + 1, 12, 31);

    function compute(col, windowLabel) {
      const size = col.size();
      const composite = col.median();
      // valid pixel count for composite
      const validPix = composite.select('green').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('green');
      const totalPix = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('green').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('green');
      const mndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['green', 'swir1']).rename('mndwi');
      const water = mndwi.gt(0); // water if MNDWI > 0
      const land = water.not();
      const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(land);
      const landArea_m2 = pixelArea.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('area');
      return ee.Dictionary({
        size: size,
        validPix: validPix,
        totalPix: totalPix,
        landArea_m2: landArea_m2,
        window: windowLabel
      });
    }

    // Try primary
    let colPrimary = getCollection(primaryStart, primaryEnd, primarySensors);
    let sizePrimary = colPrimary.size().getInfo();
    if (sizePrimary === 0) {
      // Try fallback sensors and/or window
      let colFb = getCollection(fbStart, fbEnd, fallbackSensors);
      let sizeFb = colFb.size().getInfo();
      if (sizeFb === 0) {
        return { status: 'C1', info: `Year ${year}: No images in both primary and fallback.` };
      }
      const resFb = compute(colFb, '±1y');
      const vPixFb = resFb.get('validPix').getInfo();
      if (!vPixFb || vPixFb === 0) {
        return { status: 'C2', info: `Year ${year}: 0 valid pixels after masking in fallback.` };
      }
      return {
        status: 'OK',
        year: year,
        imgs: resFb.get('size').getInfo(),
        validPix: vPixFb,
        totalPix: resFb.get('totalPix').getInfo(),
        landArea_km2: (resFb.get('landArea_m2').getInfo() || 0) / 1e6,
        window: resFb.get('window').getInfo()
      };
    } else {
      const res = compute(colPrimary, 'primary');
      const vPix = res.get('validPix').getInfo();
      if (!vPix || vPix === 0) {
        // try fallback window/sensors
        let colFb2 = getCollection(fbStart, fbEnd, fallbackSensors);
        let sizeFb2 = colFb2.size().getInfo();
        if (sizeFb2 === 0) {
          return { status: 'C2', info: `Year ${year}: 0 valid pixels after masking (no fallback).` };
        }
        const resFb2 = compute(colFb2, '±1y');
        const vPix2 = resFb2.get('validPix').getInfo();
        if (!vPix2 || vPix2 === 0) {
          return { status: 'C2', info: `Year ${year}: 0 valid pixels after masking even with fallback.` };
        }
        return {
          status: 'OK',
          year: year,
          imgs: resFb2.get('size').getInfo(),
          validPix: vPix2,
          totalPix: resFb2.get('totalPix').getInfo(),
          landArea_km2: (resFb2.get('landArea_m2').getInfo() || 0) / 1e6,
          window: resFb2.get('window').getInfo()
        };
      }
      const area_m2 = res.get('landArea_m2').getInfo();
      if (area_m2 === null || area_m2 === undefined) {
        return { status: 'C3', info: `Year ${year}: Area calculation returned null.` };
      }
      return {
        status: 'OK',
        year: year,
        imgs: res.get('size').getInfo(),
        validPix: vPix,
        totalPix: res.get('totalPix').getInfo(),
        landArea_km2: (area_m2 || 0) / 1e6,
        window: res.get('window').getInfo()
      };
    }
  }

  // 3. Run for 1999 and 2019
  const r1999 = compositeAndArea(1999, ['L5', 'L7'], ['L5', 'L7']);
  const r2019 = compositeAndArea(2019, ['L8', 'L7'], ['L8', 'L7']);

  // 4. Handle Cases and Print Evidence
  function pct(valid, total) {
    if (!total || total === 0) return null;
    return (100 * (1 - valid / total));
  }

  let failureTag = null;
  if (r1999.status !== 'OK') {
    console.log(`1999: ${r1999.info}`);
    failureTag = r1999.status;
  }
  if (r2019.status !== 'OK') {
    console.log(`2019: ${r2019.info}`);
    failureTag = failureTag || r2019.status;
  }
  if (failureTag) {
    console.log(failureTag);
    return;
  }

  const cloudPct1999 = pct(r1999.validPix, r1999.totalPix);
  const cloudPct2019 = pct(r2019.validPix, r2019.totalPix);

  // Print concise evidence (<= 20 lines)
  console.log(`AOI bounds: ${aoi.bounds().coordinates().getInfo()}`);
  console.log(`1999 Images: ${r1999.imgs} (win: ${r1999.window}), Valid pix: ${r1999.validPix}, Total pix: ${r1999.totalPix}, Cloud-masked %: ${cloudPct1999 !== null ? cloudPct1999.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
  console.log(`2019 Images: ${r2019.imgs} (win: ${r2019.window}), Valid pix: ${r2019.validPix}, Total pix: ${r2019.totalPix}, Cloud-masked %: ${cloudPct2019 !== null ? cloudPct2019.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
  console.log(`1999 Land Area (km²): ${r1999.landArea_km2.toFixed(2)}`);
  console.log(`2019 Land Area (km²): ${r2019.landArea_km2.toFixed(2)}`);
  const diff = r2019.landArea_km2 - r1999.landArea_km2;
  console.log(`Change 1999→2019 (km²): ${diff.toFixed(2)}`);

  // 5. Validation & Final Answer
  const invalid = [r1999.landArea_km2, r2019.landArea_km2].some(v => v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v));
  if (invalid) {
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }
  const decreased = diff < -0.1; // require at least 0.1 km² decrease to be robust at 1km scale
  if (decreased) {
    console.log('A');
  } else {
    console.log('B');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
